# Retire a product feature or API

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When a company plans to end a product, interface version or customer-facing capability. An authorized retirement with migrated or explicitly resolved customers, controlled shutdown and retained completion evidence.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> Operational draft. Source checked on 2026-10-30. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance, certification or completed execution is claimed. The source context is UK public-sector practice; adapted operational coordination. Resolve applicable law and expert review before external action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Inventory usage and customer commitments

agent-runnable


Identify affected customers, integrations, contracts, data and internal dependencies. Record observed usage and owners; lack of recent traffic alone does not establish that retirement is contractually permitted.

- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles) · [Google API Versioning](https://google.aip.dev/185)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Approve the retirement and customer remedy plan

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Product, legal and support owners review obligations, proposed timing, alternatives and refund or migration options. Resolve commitments and material customer risks before approving an announcement.

- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles) · [Google API Versioning](https://google.aip.dev/185)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare migration and recovery materials

agent-runnable


Draft migration instructions, compatibility tests, customer notices and an exception register. Define what evidence must exist before access or stored data can be removed.

- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles) · [Google API Versioning](https://google.aip.dev/185)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Issue approved notices and offer migration support

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


Authorized operators send the reviewed communications through approved channels. Retain delivery records and assign owners to customer objections or unsupported migrations.

- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles) · [Google API Versioning](https://google.aip.dev/185)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Verify migration and authorize shutdown

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Responsible owners review remaining users, contractual exceptions and recovery options. Stop the affected shutdown when conditions are unmet; obtain explicit approval for production or data changes.

- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles) · [Google API Versioning](https://google.aip.dev/185)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Confirm shutdown and close residual obligations

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Authorized operators perform the approved shutdown and verify monitoring, billing and data handling outcomes. Keep unresolved support or retention duties assigned and publish only verified completion status.

- Verify: An authorized retirement with migrated or explicitly resolved customers, controlled shutdown and retained completion evidence.
- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles) · [Google API Versioning](https://google.aip.dev/185)
